overview.headline: Right triangle ratios define sine cosine and tangent for flight math

keyPoints.point: Right triangle angles include a right angle and two acute angles that sum with it
keyPoints.quote: The sum of the angles of any triangle is equal to 180 degrees.

keyPoints.point: Sine relates opposite side length to hypotenuse length for a chosen angle
keyPoints.quote: We will call the ratio of the opposite side of a right triangle to the hypotenuse the sine and give it the symbol sin.

keyPoints.point: Cosine relates adjacent side length to hypotenuse length for a chosen angle
keyPoints.quote: The ratio of the adjacent side of a right triangle to the hypotenuse is called the cosine and given the symbol cos.

keyPoints.point: Tangent relates opposite side length to adjacent side length for a chosen angle
keyPoints.quote: Finally, the ratio of the opposite side to the adjacent side is called the tangent and given the symbol tan.

keyTerms.gloss: longest side across from the right angle in a right triangle
keyTerms.quote: We define the side of the triangle opposite from the right angle to be the hypotenuse.

keyTerms.gloss: side opposite the chosen angle forming sine numerator
keyTerms.quote: The ratio of the opposite to the hypotenuse is .967 and defined to be the sine of the angle c = 75.5 degrees.

keyTerms.gloss: side adjacent to the chosen angle forming cosine numerator
keyTerms.quote: The ratio of the adjacent side of a right triangle to the hypotenuse is called the cosine and given the symbol cos.

keyTerms.gloss: ratio of opposite side to adjacent side for an angle
keyTerms.quote: Finally, the ratio of the opposite side to the adjacent side is called the tangent and given the symbol tan.
